lens: independent recruiter screenshot capture, duplicate prevention, and return-to-work value

findings.observation: The executable iOS loop now turns one screenshot into one governed source and one compiled relationship page, but no working recruiter has compared its review time and return value with WeChat search, notes, an ATS, or memory.
findings.evidence: Direct Simulator evidence covers editable text, minimal relationship hints, current-versus-historical identity comparison, explicit binding, a Gold compilation receipt, and safe retry. The product research protocol still labels reuse, reconstruction time, and changed next action as unproven.
findings.user_impact: The flow prevents a dangerous wrong-person attachment and creates durable continuity, but its form length may cost more attention than it saves for low-value conversations.
findings.recommendation: Test only recent high-consequence conversations and compare immediate review plus next-contact reconstruction with the recruiter's real fallback.
findings.verification: Across five independent recruiters, record capture-to-reviewed-Wiki time, corrections, wrong or duplicate bindings, next-contact reconstruction time, changed decisions, deletion expectations, and voluntary second-case reuse.

strengths: The mobile surface is a single progressive decision rather than a contact database form or an AI chat transcript.
The recruiter sees and edits the recognized text before it becomes evidence.
A clue finds candidates but never chooses one; the current owner remains actionable while the historical owner remains visible and protected.
Keeping the source unresolved is a normal completion, so the recruiter is not forced to guess.
The completion receipt names the affected resource, person, relationship, block count, and actual quality verdict.
A failed Wiki compilation can be retried without repeating the identity decision.
The screenshot becomes another source under the relationship instead of another contact entry.
missing_evidence: A working-recruiter comparison with WeChat, notes, ATS, CRM, and memory.
Voluntary reuse on a second real or consented redacted case.
Measured value at the next contact or decision moment.
A physical-device Photos and Shortcuts handoff.
High-volume capture behavior when several pending screenshots accumulate.
open_questions: Can name, handle, and relationship purpose collapse behind one confirmable suggestion when the screenshot already supports them, without weakening review?
Is the strongest return action opening the person page, asking Chat for a pre-contact brief, or placing the relationship in Today?
